feature_name: Event Handler Consolidation for Upload Component
description: Update the upload component to use the centralized get_event_handler function instead of its current event handling implementation. This change will ensure consistent event handling patterns across the codebase and reduce duplication of event-related logic.
functional_requirements: Replace the upload component's current event handling mechanism with calls to the get_event_handler function
Ensure all existing upload functionality remains unchanged after the refactor
Maintain backward compatibility with existing upload component usage patterns
Verify that event handling works correctly for all upload-related operations
